title: 걷어간 노트의 그 페이지
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie ballad. A clean, warm-toned electric guitar plays arpeggiated chords with light chorus and reverb. A soft, melodic bass guitar follows the root notes with a rounded, fingerstyle tone. Male baritone vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate style with close-mic proximity. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the vocal melody and the guitar's rhythmic picking. Key of C Major. Tempo is 72 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar arpeggio with light reverb]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals enter]
백 번 십 분 전이었다
안내 방송이 울렸다
관람 시간이 [bass guitar enters] 종료됩니다

사람들이 가방을
챙겼다
출구로 걸어갔다
발소리가 대리석에 울렸다
전시실이 비어갔다

3번 전시실에
한 사람이 남아 있었다
